Catherine Russell has enjoyed an active career as a jazz and pop vocalist. She has provided background vocals for a lengthy list of notable recording artists, including David Bowie, Paul Simon, Steely Dan, and James Taylor. Catherine has made the transition to a leader of her own group and has headlined at major jazz venues both here and abroad.
Catherine was interviewed on October 26, 2018 in Utica, NY by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have Catherine Russell with me today in Utica, before a gig at Hamilton College. Welcome.
